channel.title: Fit-All Belt
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Fit-All Belt" - A belt that can fit almost anyone, and performs strange behaviours based on the loop that is used, and the width of the wearer.

item.title: Re: Fit-All Belt
item.content:encoded: Thank you Doctor Ramses for your input, I will spell and grammer check my entries from thus forward, and I will scrap this SCP. But thank you for the valuable input.

item.title: Re: Fit-All Belt
item.content:encoded: Apologies if I come across as blunt, but this idea in its current state feels rather bland. The anomaly in question is so inconsequential that it raises the question as to how the Foundation would be alerted to it in the first place, it just feels like something you'd see in a Marshall, Carter, & Dark fashion catalog. And the "strangely dangerous encounter" is too vague for us to know whether it's a good hook or not. Last, and this is just an easily fixable nitpick, but your spelling errors don't inspire a great deal of confidence. There are over 5000 entries on this site, you need to think about how to make your idea stand out among them.

item.title: Fit-All Belt
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: The Basic idea is that it is a belt that is able to adjust to any person who wears or uses the belt.

Central Narrative: The SCP is just a belt that adjusts to the size poeple need it and the fact that it is so normal compared to other SCPs, and even when things go wrong, the containment procedures for the belt are still minimal, they really know almost nothing about this SCP and that is what makes it so intresting.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: After some experiments with the belt, it is descovered that it may actually have its limitations, after a D-Class personell has a strangely dangerous encounter with the belt

Additional Notes: I am willing to revise my SCP so if you have any suggestiong please post them below, and I will adjust the SCP accordingly, and I would enjoy of you would then see the new and revised edit, Thanks!
